resources.string: Allows Launcher Switcher to change the system default launcher.
This app is not Device Owner yet.
Reset via Shizuku is unsupported; use Device Owner or Dhizuku to reset.
Set %1$s as the default home app?
Change the default launcher to %1$s?\n\nNote: Device Owner is permanent until explicitly revoked via ADB. Consider using Dhizuku or Shizuku instead.
Device Owner setup (run once via ADB, no accounts on device):\n\nadb shell dpm set-device-owner com.example.launcherswitcher/.MyDeviceAdminReceiver

This app switches your device's default launcher using elevated privileges.

Three authorization modes are supported (in priority order):

1. Device Owner — most powerful, set via ADB on a clean device.
2. Dhizuku — share Device Owner permissions from the Dhizuku app.
3. Shizuku — run shell commands as root/ADB identity via a background service.

Choose the mode that matches your device setup, then tap a launcher below to switch.
